applicant.organisation: Federal Ministry of Social Affairs, Health, Care and Consumer Protection, health promotion unit

purpose: We are planning a public health-promotion campaign, including posters and radio spots, to advertise the free national diabetes prevention programme in the regions with the highest burden.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
